what_it_does: Running large language models on-device (e.g., on a phone) requires efficient use of both the main processor and specialized memory-based compute units. The problem: during model inference, some phases need matrix multiplication (GEMM) with model weights arranged one way in memory, while other phases need vector-matrix products (GEMV) with weights arranged a different way for the memory-based unit. Copying or rearranging the data between phases wastes time. FACIL solves this by giving the memory controller the ability to present the same physical data in two different logical layouts simultaneously—the prefill phase sees one arrangement, the decode phase sees another, all without moving bytes.
